display_name: 双压力区矩形射频离子处理器
purpose: 由简化实体电极与原生SIMION求场复现多极杆输运、捕获、碰撞冷却、聚集、整体抬升和正交引出
known_gaps: Simplified solid-electrode geometry is a functional abstraction, not a complete manufacturer mechanical reconstruction
Native N100 functional baseline and user GUI confirmation are recorded; full spatial and whole-flight time-step convergence remain unqualified
Ion-neutral collision cross section is an uncalibrated placeholder, not a measured N2/524amu value
No fragmentation, space charge, gas-flow solution or manufacturer CAD qualification
COMSOL projection remains unimplemented; measured upstream multipole admission and downstream MR state/clock handoff exist, but their original performance gates did not pass
Analytical prescribed-field workflow is retired; the active functional workflow uses native solid-electrode fields
Public execution planning covers only the existing 524 Da/+1 functional source and fixed configuration; custom, exploration and upstream-injected workflows retain their project-specific entrypoints
